propositions: Doctor lock census does not probe snapshot-GC worker lock at snapshot store root, leaving stale locks from dead snapshot-GC workers undetectable by diagnostic tools.
Snapshot-GC worker lock is held at per-host store root (not tracker .rebar dir) and uses same v2 stamped-lock format as drain and compact-worker legs, enabling shared staleness table.
Snapshot store root derivation must be read-only for diagnostic pass (no mkdir/chmod side effects) to preserve census invariant that probing never creates what it probes.
Snapshot-GC worker lock leg reports held-for, holder, and staleness status via existing _existence_report reader when store exists; reports free when store absent (lock file does not exist).
New doctor_locks leg requires non-creating peek_store_root() seam in repo_snapshot and worker_lock_probe_path() in gc_trigger to derive per-host path without directory materialization.
Doctor JSON schema and test suite must be updated to recognize snapshot-gc-worker leg as sixth census leg with per-host scope separate from tracker-adjacent roots.
